buttonClasses: a.button (+ .primary / .secondary / .accent) inside p.button-wrapper; all styled as the yellow pill (source .btn.btn-secondary): display table, margin 2rem auto 0
buttonization:
formatted-only (authored / around a lone link in a

)

fonts.loadedBy: styles/fonts.css (scripts.js loadFonts: eager on >=900px after the first section, lazy otherwise)

body: font var(--f-light) 16px/1.5, color #3c3c3b; h1-h6 margin 0 0 .5rem weight 500 lh 1.2; h2 2rem var(--f-bold) uppercase #3c3c3c; p margin 0 0 1rem; ul unstyled

sections.container: main > .section > div (default-content-wrapper / <block>-wrapper): width 100%, padding 0 15px, margin 0 auto, max-width 540 (>=576) / 720 (>=768) / 960 (>=992) / 1140 = var(--container) (>=1200)

sectionMetadataStyles.fluid: wrappers max-width none (source .section-fluid: full width, 15px gutters)
sectionMetadataStyles.flush: band padding 0 (full-bleed blocks, e.g. the hero)

sections.sectionTitle: every default-content h2 (main .default-content-wrapper > h2) and any .section-title: centered, ::after yellow 5px rule 10% wide, margin .5em auto 1.5em

header.host: body > header: position sticky, top 0, z-index 1020; height var(--nav-height) until the block loads, then auto
header.scrollState: .header.scrolled toggled when window.scrollY > 100, at every width
header.classes: header .header > a.skip-link + nav.navbar > .navbar-inner > a.navbar-brand + .navs > (.topnav > .topnav-collapse > ul.topnav-menu, ul.list-social) + (.primarynav > button.navbar-toggler, ul.main-menu#main-menu > li.nav-item[.has-dropdown|.nav-item-cta])
header.dropdowns: click to open (li.is-open), close on outside click / Escape; absolute under the trigger at >=1200, static in the mobile menu
header.skipLinkTarget: main gets id="main" from the header block (skip link href #main)
header.authoredDocument: /nav: section 1 = skip link + brand logo link; section 2 = top links list + social list (:icon: spans); section 3 = primary menu list (text item + nested list = dropdown; <strong> link = CTA pill); metadata Robots noindex

footer.authoredDocument: /footer: section 1 = FCC logo link; section 2 = social list (:icon: spans) + Privacy link; metadata Robots noindex

breakpoints.1200: container 1140; desktop header (top links visible, toggler hidden, inline primary menu)
breakpoints.1200-1469: primary/top nav items font-size .75rem, margin 0 .1rem (0.9rem / 0 .4rem otherwise)

media: chrome logos are SVG in DA /media/chrome/ (content.da.live); header/footer blocks drop the webp <source>s so the vector renders
